criteria.label: Work authorization
criteria.candidateQuestion: Are you authorized to work in the job location?
criteria.explanation: This role requires current work authorization.

criteria.label: Availability
criteria.candidateQuestion: Which days and times are you available to work?
criteria.explanation: The retail team needs weekend availability.

criteria.label: Location
criteria.candidateQuestion: Are you located in or able to commute to Chicago?
criteria.explanation: This role is based in Chicago.

criteria.label: Experience
criteria.candidateQuestion: How many years of relevant customer-facing experience do you have?
criteria.explanation: The role expects at least two years of relevant experience.

criteria.label: Interview slot
criteria.candidateQuestion: Which available interview slot works best for you?
criteria.explanation: The candidate must select an available interview slot.
